description: Erection of a rear dormer roof extension and installation of 3 x front roof lights to an existing HMO (Class C4)
decision_conditions: The proposed roof-level unit, by reason of the provision of a sub-standard layout and insufficient information would result in the provision of housing with an unacceptable standard of accommodation to the detriment of the residential amenities of the future occupiers of the development, and contrary to policies D6 (Housing quality and standards) and D7 (Accessible housing) of the London Plan 2021 and policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan 2020.

The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement to secure a contribution towards affordable housing fails to deliver the maximum reasonable amount of affordable housing and is therefore contrary to policy H4 (Delivering affordable housing) of the London Plan (2021), policy LP13 (Affordable housing) of Hackney’s Local Plan 2033 (2020) and Hackney's S106 Planning Contributions SPD (2020).

The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement to secure car-free housing, would be likely to promote the use of non-sustainable modes of transport and contribute to air pollution and congestion in the surrounding area, contrary to policy T6 of the London Plan (2021), policy LP45 (Parking and Car Free Development) and LP58 (Improving the Environment - Pollution) of Hackney’s Local Plan 2033 (2020) and Hackney's S106 Planning Contributions SPD (2020).

The proposed development, in the absence of a legal agreement to secure a carbon offset contribution, would fail to mitigate the impact of the development on climate change and maximise sustainable development contrary to contrary to policy SI2 (Minimising Greenhouse Gas Emissions) of the London Plan (2021), policy LP55 (Mitigating Climate Change) of Hackney’s Local Plan 2033 (2020) and Hackney's S106 Planning Contributions SPD (2020).

The proposed development, by reason of its excessive bulk, scale, massing, detailed design, position and location would result in an incongruous and incompatible form of development which would fail to respect the character and appearance of the subject property and the terrace of which it forms part. As such the proposed development is contrary to policies D1, D3 and D4  of the London Plan 2021, policy LP1 of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and the guidance contained within Hackney Residential Extension and Alterations SPD 2026.
